parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Extracting the shared DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init into a common location would couple the production DebugPanel package to a demonstration fixture, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication here is intentional: the sample app independently re-implements the same async iterator shape for local demonstration purposes.
